description: This file defines the interface for a command-line options parser class 'Options' within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It declares constructors, destructor, member functions, and private data members related to parsing command-line arguments and options.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for command-line options parsing, including methods for checking errors, retrieving commands, requesting usage information, and parsing options.

methods.name: Options
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Options object with argument count, arguments array, and options string.

methods.name: HasErrors
methods.description: Checks if the options parsing encountered errors.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Returns the command string parsed from arguments.

methods.name: RequestUsage
methods.description: Indicates whether the user requested help/usage information.

methods.name: Option
methods.description: Pure virtual method to process a specific option and its argument.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Method to parse the command-line arguments (implementation not shown).

methods.name: RequestUsage (protected)
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating a request for usage information.
